rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something no longer current or fashionable.

example.english: The plot of that movie is very dated.
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 hou2 gwo3 si4

rows.note: Use this for an item that has a date written or marked on it, rather than one that is outdated.

example.english: This ticket is dated, so don't tear it up.
example.traditional: 呢張票有日期嘅，唔好撕爛。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 piu3 jau5 jat6 kei4 ge3 m4 hou2 si1 laan6
